node.label: CSF anti-NMDA receptor antibody positivity
node.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against the NMDA (N-methyl-D-aspartate)-type glutamate receptor.

evidence.snippet: NMDA receptor encephalitis: CSF anti-NMDA receptor antibody positivity (frequency HP:0040281) [TAS]
CSF anti-NMDA receptor antibody positivity — Very frequent (99-80%)
